# Next Suite Extra Icons Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Add exactly FolderIcon and FolderOpenIcon as original artwork in a self-contained native package, generated by the existing generator and distributed/documented without altering the 332 Radix icons.

**Architecture:** Parameterize the current build-time generator's root/viewBox and copy existing native helpers into the extra package. Keep client/server/type/export shapes identical to the original package. One FAST-icons edit owner handles package/generator/assets fixtures; shared manifests/consumer/workflow changes belong to the designated native integration/gate worker.

**Tech Stack:** Existing Node24/pnpm11.5/Vite8.3.3, exact Solid RC15 peers, TS7.0.2 producer/TS5.9.3 consumer; no new generator, optimizer or dependency.

**Spec:** `../specs/2026-10-14-next-suite-icons-extra-design.md`; [master](2026-10-14-next-suite.md) and sibling `radix2solid-web:docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-14-next-suite-website.md`. Corrected private FAST addendum was consumed as source mapping, not as authority overriding specs/website scope.

## Global Constraints

- Directory/name `packages/icons-extra` / `@wsagency/radix2solid-icons-extra`. Exactly `{ "FolderIcon": "folder.svg", "FolderOpenIcon": "folder-open.svg" }`; no collision with original icons.json. No brand/downstream artwork or speculative catalog.
- Source candidate **0.1.0-rc.3** for all five packages. Read-only registry observations reported by Main on 2026-10-14: four existing packages' rc.3 endpoints returned404, no rc.3 time entry; extra package and rc.3 returned404. This establishes only no public rc.3 observed, not name rights, unused/reservable name or never-unpublished version. DevOps confirms publication eligibility; no npm tag/auth/publish in this workstream.
- Original 332 SVGs, names, assets, defaults and every generated source byte stay identical; existing package version may advance only under the integration-owned suite version step. Existing README gets required extra-package pointer, not rewritten historical bundle figures.
- Default size15, viewBox `0 0 24 24`, root fill none; path stroke currentColor/1.6/round caps/joins, visually reviewed beside existing glyphs at15px. Native explicit width/height/viewBox and other props retain precedence.
- Sole generator stays `packages/icons/scripts/generate.ts`; no runtime factory/new dependency/cross-package runtime or declaration import. Extra generate script's intentional `node ../icons/scripts/generate.ts .` is a repository-only build reference, not a runtime leak.
- FAST edit worker performs no checks/build/format/Git and spawns no agents. Designated native gate worker executes and records serialized commands, regeneration, visual proof and Git under tool-less Main. Shared files are changed only by that integration owner.

## Review Focus

- Generator root defaults must keep all332 original generated bytes unchanged: I1 hashes original complete inventory before/after.
- Alternate viewBox must not silently mix grids or change size/prop override semantics: I1 rejects unsupported/mixed grids, I2 checks rendering.
- Helper/title ownership must survive fresh CSR and hydration without original-icons imports: I2 named SVG title/refs/events and tree-shaking.
- API/type enumeration must distinguish two extras from332 and avoid false declaration-count changes: I2 packed checks use iconsExtra consistently.
- Source candidate documentation must not imply new npm availability or invented authorship: I1 provenance and master release/site gates.

## Task I1: Original two-icon package and same-generator extension

**Files owned by FAST:** Modify `packages/icons/scripts/generate.ts`, `packages/icons/README.md`. Create `packages/icons-extra/package.json`, `icons.json`, `icons/folder.svg`, `icons/folder-open.svg`, `vite.config.ts`, `tsconfig.json`, `LICENSE`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`. Generated outputs (gate-owned generator execution, FAST owns source intent): `src/FolderIcon.tsx`, `src/FolderOpenIcon.tsx`, `src/index.ts`, `src/types.ts`, `src/title.ts`. All latter paths are inside `packages/icons-extra`.

**Interfaces:** `IconProps` identical to existing native SVG props + size/color/title, children never. Root exports type plus two named components; deep `./*Icon` exports named/default; `./icons/*.svg` exports untouched assets. `generate`=`node ../icons/scripts/generate.ts .`; `build`=`pnpm generate && vite build && vite build --ssr && tsc -p tsconfig.json`; peers solid-js/@solidjs/web both2.0.0-rc.15, dependencies none. Vite/tsconfig copied byte-for-byte from icons. Manifest private=false/type=module/sideEffects=false/public publish config/repository metadata/files follow icons, adjusted directory/homepage/name/version; files are dist/icons/LICENSE/README/CHANGELOG.

### Gate commands (designated integration/gate worker only)

```sh
node packages/icons/scripts/generate.ts
pnpm --filter @wsagency/radix2solid-icons-extra generate
pnpm --filter @wsagency/radix2solid-icons-extra build
# Settled integrated suite only, not repeated for each icon task:
pnpm build
pnpm typecheck
node tests/consumer/run.ts --scope=next-core
# New extra-icons case in remaining matching browser projects only:
GALLERY_PACKED=1 pnpm exec playwright test e2e/assets.spec.ts --grep 'extra icons' --project=firefox-ssr --project=firefox-csr --project=webkit-ssr --project=webkit-csr
```

The Node hash snapshot/compare, temporary negative generator probes and gallery visual record use the private ledger workspace. They are concrete gate operations, not committed ad-hoc scripts or product tests. The existing mandatory CI `pnpm check` remains unchanged in intent; npm publication stays maintainer/DevOps-controlled even when source/site are deployed.

All seven spec acceptance criteria map: byte identity→I1; exact catalog/grid/size→I1/I2; packed export/type/collision/leak contract→I2; SSR/hydration/title/color/decorative→I2; truthful provenance/MIT/reused notices→I1; gallery/native docs/website catalogue/install→I1/I2 plus website plan; five-package workflow and intended-only npm status→master Task9.
